oe_reg2_curtain_dowager_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = MNG
			has_or_had_tag = MCH
			has_or_had_tag = JEC
			has_or_had_tag = KOR
			has_or_had_tag = DAI
			has_or_had_tag = WUU
			has_or_had_tag = CSH
			has_or_had_tag = CSO
			AND = {
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			tag = CHI
			tag = YUA
			tag = GLH
			tag = TIM
			has_or_had_tag = MOS
			has_or_had_tag = RUS
			has_or_had_tag = NOV
			has_or_had_tag = TVE
			has_or_had_tag = RYA
		}
		NOR = {
			has_or_had_tag = TUR
			has_or_had_tag = JAL
			has_or_had_tag = INJ
			has_or_had_tag = CHB
			has_or_had_tag = QAR
			has_or_had_tag = AQQ
			has_or_had_tag = IRA
			has_or_had_tag = MZF
			has_or_had_tag = SRB
			has_or_had_tag = POL
			has_or_had_tag = PLC
			has_or_had_tag = LIT
			has_or_had_tag = MAZ
			has_or_had_tag = TRE
			has_or_had_tag = EPI
			has_or_had_tag = MOE
			has_or_had_tag = SER
			has_or_had_tag = BUL
			has_or_had_tag = GEO
			has_or_had_tag = ETH
			has_reform = government_reform:shogunate
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
		}
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		has_consort = yes
		consort ?= {
			is_adult = yes
			modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
		}
		NOT = { is_at_war_with = consort.employer }
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.08
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.06
		stability_investment = small_stability_investment
		subject_loyalty = 5
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg2_active_type value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = root.consort }
			set_regent = root.consort
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:crown_estate
					age = 38
					female = yes
					adm = 62
					dip = 58
					mil = 42
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_inst.2 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg2_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg2_active_type
		}
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_inst_reg2_curtain_legacy_mod
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

oe_reg2_guming_council_regency = {
	allow = {
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = MNG
			has_or_had_tag = MCH
			has_or_had_tag = JEC
			has_or_had_tag = KOR
			has_or_had_tag = DAI
			has_or_had_tag = WUU
			has_or_had_tag = CSH
			has_or_had_tag = CSO
			AND = {
				exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			}
		}
		NOR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			tag = CHI
			tag = YUA
			tag = GLH
			tag = TIM
			has_or_had_tag = MOS
			has_or_had_tag = RUS
			has_or_had_tag = NOV
			has_or_had_tag = TVE
			has_or_had_tag = RYA
		}
		NOR = {
			has_or_had_tag = TUR
			has_or_had_tag = JAL
			has_or_had_tag = INJ
			has_or_had_tag = CHB
			has_or_had_tag = QAR
			has_or_had_tag = AQQ
			has_or_had_tag = IRA
			has_or_had_tag = MZF
			has_or_had_tag = SRB
			has_or_had_tag = POL
			has_or_had_tag = PLC
			has_or_had_tag = LIT
			has_or_had_tag = MAZ
			has_or_had_tag = TRE
			has_or_had_tag = EPI
			has_or_had_tag = MOE
			has_or_had_tag = SER
			has_or_had_tag = BUL
			has_or_had_tag = GEO
			has_or_had_tag = ETH
			has_reform = government_reform:shogunate
			culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
		}
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		NOT = { ruler ?= { is_expedition_leader = yes } }
		NOT = {
			AND = {
				has_consort = yes
				consort ?= {
					is_adult = yes
					modifier:blocked_from_cabinet = no
				}
				NOT = { is_at_war_with = consort.employer }
			}
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		legislative_efficiency = 0.10
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.08
		global_nobles_estate_power = 0.08
		monthly_legitimacy = -0.04
	}

	start_effect = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg2_active_type value = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_cabinet_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = { can_become_a_regent = yes }
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					OR = {
						has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
						has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					}
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					OR = {
						has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate
						has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					}
				}
				order_by = adm
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
					age = 50
					female = no
					adm = 66
					dip = 54
					mil = 52
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_inst.3 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg2_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg2_active_type
		}
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_inst_reg2_guming_legacy_mod
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}

				any_cabinet_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					religion = root.religion
				}
			}
			ordered_cabinet_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					religion = root.religion
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
					religion = root.religion
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					can_become_a_regent = yes
					has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
					religion = root.religion
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = new_leader
			}
			set_regent = scope:new_leader
		}
		else = {
			hidden_effect = {
				create_character = {
					culture = root.culture
					religion = root.religion
					estate = estate_type:clergy_estate
					age = 52
					female = no
					adm = 60
					dip = 58
					mil = 46
					save_scope_as = new_leader
				}
				set_regent = scope:new_leader
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_inst.8 days = 1 }
		}
	}

	end_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_reg2_active_type }
			remove_variable = oe_reg2_active_type
		}
		add_religious_influence = religious_influence_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_inst_reg2_synkletos_legacy_mod
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}
}
